			NOT = { has_global_variable = cwp_fig_EGY_abdel_hakim_amer }
			NOT = { is_template_used = cwp_fig_EGY_abdel_hakim_amer }
			game_date >= 1952.1.1
			game_date < 1967.1.1
			exists = c:EGY
		}
		set_global_variable = cwp_fig_EGY_abdel_hakim_amer
		c:EGY = { create_character = { template = cwp_fig_EGY_abdel_hakim_amer on_created = { set_variable = cwp_fig } } }
	}
